Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Slidell for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (A Christmas Story, The Musical at Slidell Little Theatre) through December 20, with Christmas Under the Stars at Heritage Park (December 11, 12, 18 and 19), the Krewe of Kringle Golf Cart Parade (December 13) and Cookies and Cocoa with Santa at The Harbor Center (December 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
